subject: Vendor intake: Greenridge Supply — initial PO sequencing and line-code question
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@greenridge.tools>
To: chloe.martin@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2027-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New vendor: Greenridge Supply — pilot onboarding and PO question

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for taking our call this morning. We're excited to get the 3-month pilot started with Redwood. We're ready to submit the onboarding form but had a quick question about how you issue provisional PO numbers and how spend caps map to line items.

Quick context: our initial shipment will be billed as two SKUs (GR-2001 and GR-2002). Historically our accounts team sees a single PO line for both SKUs and then an invoice with itemized rows; for the pilot we want a clear mapping so spend cap enforcement doesn't block invoices.

Can Redwood provision a temporary PO number for the pilot that: 
- carries a single spend cap for the pilot period, and
- allows us to submit an invoice with two line entries mapped back to that PO?

If there are preferred line codes or an allocation template you use, please send and we'll align. Attached: our preliminary onboarding worksheet (spreadsheet export).

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if easier.

Best,
Tara Singh
Head of Partnerships, Greenridge Supply
T: +1 415-555-0104

Attachment: greenridge_onboard_workbook.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood-inference.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@greenridge.tools>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor: Greenridge Supply — pilot onboarding and PO question

Tara — thanks for the clear note and the workbook. Welcome aboard.

Short answers up front: yes, we can provision a provisional PO number for the pilot and support multiple invoice lines against that PO. A couple of things to make it smooth:

1) Spend cap vs line mapping
- We typically issue a single provisional PO number for pilots with a total spend cap (e.g., $50,000). Invoices can have multiple line items but the PO is checked against the aggregate spend.
- If you need per-SKU sub-limits (e.g., cap $30k on GR-2001 and $20k on GR-2002), we need that specified on our allocation template so procurement can encode it as separate line buckets.

2) Line codes and allocation template
- See attached PO-alloc-template.xlsx (simple example). Use column "line_code" and include SKU, description, and cap per line if you want per-item enforcement.

3) Timing and documents we need
- Completed onboarding form (PDF)
- W-9 / tax ID (or equivalent)
- Banking details or remit instructions for ACH/Payables

Action items:
- Tara: complete the attached onboarding_form.pdf and return with tax/banking. If you want separate sub-caps, indicate amounts in column C of the template.
- Monica: can you provision the provisional PO number and confirm temporary spend cap flow for pilot accounts?
- Ben: FYI on billing/ACH validation once we have the form.

If helpful I can schedule a 20-min sync later today.

Thanks,
Chloe
Senior Program Manager, Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: onboarding_form.pdf (fillable PDF stub), PO-alloc-template.xlsx (template)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood-inference.com>, Tara Singh <tara.singh@greenridge.tools>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T13:14:00-07:00
Subject: RE: New vendor: Greenridge Supply — pilot onboarding and PO question

Chloe / Tara — looped in and happy to action.

Chloe: I'll generate a provisional PO number for the pilot today (we use the "PILOT-YYYY-NNN" series). I'll set the provisional spend cap at the aggregate amount you confirm and flag the PO as "provisional" in the ledger so it tolerates immediate invoices while we finish full vendor validation.

Tara: a few operational notes so invoices don't get auto-rejected: 
- Use the PO number in the Invoice header and include per-line "line_code" where possible (see template column A).
- For now, if you send a single invoice with two lines (GR-2001 / GR-2002) we will accept it against the provisional PO. Aggregate spend will be measured against the PO cap.
- If you request splitting a line (e.g., GR-2001 => 2001A / 2001B), please provide the rationale and the mapping in the template; procurement can create sub-line codes (2001A/2001B) but it requires an internal ledger entry and may delay finalization by 24–48 hours.

I'll:
- create the provisional PO (will reply with the PO id and the temporary cap), and
- attach the internal provisioning checklist so you know which fields must be provided for final activation.

Ben — after the PO is created, please review vendor remit details once Tara returns the completed form.

Thanks,
Monica
Manager, Vendor Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachment: internal_provisioning_checklist.pdf (procurement checklist stub)

From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@greenridge.tools>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T11:37:00-07:00
Subject: RE: New vendor: Greenridge Supply — pilot onboarding and PO question

Monica / Chloe — attaching the completed onboarding_form.pdf and a scanned W-9.

A couple of follow-ups re: line handling that came up on our end: 
1) We deliver GR-2001 as a bundled kit but need it billed as two distinct components for our accounting (2001A = electronics, 2001B = packaging). Can you create sub-line 2001A/2001B tied to the provisional PO so invoices can present both line codes? We asked because our ERP will export them as separate invoice rows.

2) For the pilot we'll accept aggregate spend cap tracking. Please provision PO with cap: $35,000. If possible, set soft-warning thresholds at $25k and $33k so our AM gets an email in advance.

3) Attached is the completed onboarding_form.pdf (signed) and W-9. We also uploaded banking details to the secure vendor form link you provided: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cGreenridgeOnboard

Thanks — happy to wait 24–48 hours for sub-line creation if needed. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Tara
Head of Partnerships, Greenridge Supply

Attachments: signed_onboarding_form.pdf, W-9_Greenridge.pdf
